raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the profession of Eric Ambler and Carol Shields as "screenwriters" without verifying the facts. Eric Ambler is a renowned British novelist and screenwriter, while Carol Shields is a celebrated Canadian novelist (winner of the Booker Prize). While Ambler wrote screenplays, Shields is primarily known as a novelist, and neither is "best known" primarily as a screenwriter in the same way they are as authors. The Planner failed to use the available tools (WebSurfer) to verify the information and made an unfounded assumption, leading to the wrong conclusion.
